content.title: About
content.content: Frozen garlic bread is a ready‑to‑bake product that includes a flavorful garlic butter spread, herbs, and cheese. After thawing and baking, it develops a crisp crust and a soft, aromatic interior.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Garlic bread is a classic starter in Italian restaurants, often served alongside pasta.
Freezing preserves the fresh garlic aroma for several months without loss of flavor.
Traditional recipes add olive oil, Parmesan, and fresh herbs such as parsley or basil.
In many countries garlic bread is a popular street‑food snack.

items.title: Rich in garlic compounds
items.content: Garlic contains sulfur compounds like allicin, which have antioxidant and anti‑inflammatory effects.

items.title: Source of vitamin B6
items.content: Vitamin B6 supports protein metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Iron from the bread and garlic helps maintain healthy blood hemoglobin levels.

items.title: Provides complex carbohydrates
items.content: The bread supplies slowly digestible carbs that provide sustained energy and satiety.

items.title: Includes healthy fats
items.content: Butter and occasional olive oil add monounsaturated fats that are beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The bread contains wheat, so people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity should avoid it.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Butter and seasoning can raise the salt level, which may be a concern for hypertension.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Garlic bread is calorie‑rich; portion control is advisable, especially on weight‑loss diets.

items.title: Garlic allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to garlic, ranging from mild skin irritation to severe anaphylaxis.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Thaw the bread at room temperature or in the refrigerator, then bake in a preheated oven for 10‑15 minutes until golden. Serve hot as a standalone snack or alongside pasta, soups, and salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen garlic bread in the freezer at –18 °C. After thawing, consume within 2‑3 days and do not refreeze once fully defrosted.
